title: fix(service-messaging): Notification Preferences says which topics and channels can be entered
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuRnMeoGgdWq8MSdroEhKis3)_

Fixes #25346

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim of record: `6365308855` on the card (card thread, `domain:services` seat 1). Ruling of record: `6365616409` (letter **A**, Sales, on the needs_decision in os-dev-report `6365345478`). Branch `claude/project-thread-8hqiya` is the harness-pinned branch for this session. It names no issue, so the Duplicate Fix Guard's branch-name hint will not match, and the claim is the identity record.

## What changes

Setup → Notification Preferences showed Topic and Channel as bare text boxes. Their help only said "Notification topic" and "Channel id (inbox/email/push/…)", and no `push` channel exists. The card asked for pickers wherever the platform can enumerate the values. The measurement in the report found that neither field can be a picker without a contract change:

- **Topics.** A topic is whatever string the sender writes, and nothing registers topics.
- **Channels.** Channels are registered at runtime through an open seam: `MessagingChannel` is exported, and `registerChannel` is public. A `select` does not fit:
  - it is closed on the write path;
  - its option values are `SystemIdentifierSchema`, so the stored `*` wildcard cannot be an option.

Ruling A keeps both fields as `text` and makes the help say what to type. `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-preference.object.ts`:

- **Channel help:** `inbox` (always available), `email` (once an email service is configured), `sms` (once an SMS service is configured), or the id of a channel an installed plugin adds. Enter `*` for all channels. An id no channel uses matches nothing. `push` is gone.
- **Topic help:** the topic a flow's notify step names, or one the platform sends, such as `approval.requested` or `collab.mention`. Enter `*` for all topics. A topic nothing sends matches nothing.

The type, default (`*`), `maxLength`, index and resolver are unchanged. No stored row changes meaning and no write is newly refused.

The comments beside both declarations record why the field is not a picker.

Translation bundles:

- `en` was regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`.
- `zh-CN`, `es-ES` and `ja-JP` were translated by hand. The es-ES and ja-JP leaves were byte copies of the old English source, which `check:i18n-stale-fill` reds on. Re-translating them dropped their two entries from each `*.source-hashes.generated.ts`, as the tool writes it.

## Pins

New file `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-preference-topic-channel-help.test.ts`, 3 cases:

- **Both fields stay free text.** Each is `text` with default `*`, and its help says `Enter * for all`.
- **The channel help names exactly the built-in channels.** The pin compares it with the `id`s read from the three channel factories this package builds (`createInboxChannel`, `createEmailChannel`, `createSmsChannel`). So a channel added or renamed here fails until the help says so. The help names none of the spec vocabulary's ids that no channel implements (`push`, `webhook`, `slack`, `teams`, `in-app`), and it says a plugin's own channel is valid.
- **The topic help says where a topic comes from.** It names the notify step and an example topic.

**Ablation leg:** the object file was restored from `f0fdd45b` (base) and the pin file run: 3 failed. HEAD: 3 passed. The file was restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, and `git diff --quiet HEAD` passed. No `dist/` leg is needed, because the pin imports source.

## Tests and gates

Read on `2d1b522b`. Then `main` was merged in, giving head `ad7975f4`. None of the 7 incoming commits touches a `service-messaging` path, so nothing was re-run.

- **Package tests:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging test`: `Test Files 61 passed (61)`, `Tests 729 passed (729)`.
- **Type check and lint:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging typecheck`: exit 0. `eslint` on the two changed source files: exit 0.
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 68 commands, and all 68 exit 0. Three needed a prerequisite first:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` ran after its pinned fixture commit was fetched;
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` ran after the 8 dists it named were built;
  - `check:i18n-stale-fill` ran after the es-ES and ja-JP re-translation.
- **`--ran` reconcile:** `68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- **Not run locally, declared to CI:** the type-check lanes and the path-scheduled CI jobs. No dogfood battery is owed: there is no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's "Done when" asks for pickers wherever the platform can enumerate the values. Per the ruling, neither field gets one. A real dropdown over an open vocabulary would need a spec-lane suggestion list on text fields (the report's option C). That is not part of this card and is not filed by it.
- The help also says a plugin's own channel id is accepted, and that a value nothing uses matches nothing. Both describe today's behaviour, within ruling A.
